name: Everyday Math City - Real-World Life Simulator
description: Interactive real-world simulation for money transactions, unitary price comparisons, elapsed time intervals, distance-speed-time travel, and household budgeting across the 5-stage mastery model.
author: TezMindz Olympiad Team

stages.name: Concept Discovery
stages.focus: Manipulate currency notes/coins or clock hands, observe change returned and elapsed intervals live

stages.name: Guided Simulation
stages.focus: Solve authentic real-world shopping or schedule missions with 4-tier progressive hints

stages.name: Rule Discovery
stages.focus: Formulate core applied math rules: Change = Paid - Bill, Elapsed Time = End - Start

stages.name: Controlled Practice
stages.focus: Dynamic variations across currencies (₹, $, £), unitary item packs, and train schedules

stages.name: Anti-Memorisation Assessment
stages.focus: Unseen multi-step story problem solved purely with mental calculations without visual registers

sampleData.prompt: Rohan bought 3 notebooks at ₹45 each and 2 geometry pens at ₹25 each in Everyday Math City. He paid with a ₹500 note. How much balance change should he receive back?
sampleData.subPrompt: Calculate total cost of all purchased items first, then subtract from cash tendered.
progressiveHints: Level 1 (Attention): First, find the total cost of 3 notebooks: 3 × ₹45.
Level 2 (Reasoning): 3 × 45 = ₹135. Cost of 2 pens = 2 × ₹25 = ₹50. Total bill = 135 + 50 = ₹185.
Level 3 (Demonstration): Rohan gave the cashier ₹500. Change Returned = Amount Paid - Total Bill = 500 - 185.
Level 4 (Full Solution): 500 - 185 = ₹315. Rohan receives ₹315 in change.

ruleDiscovery.statementPrompt: Complete the fundamental rule of consumer money transactions:
ruleOptions: Change Returned = Total Paid - Total Cost of Items
Change Returned = Total Paid + Total Cost of Items
Change Returned = Total Cost multiplied by number of notes
ruleDiscovery.correctRule: Change Returned = Total Paid - Total Cost of Items

sampleData.explanation: Cost of notebooks = 3 × 45 = ₹135. Cost of pens = 2 × 25 = ₹50. Total bill = ₹185. Change = 500 - 185 = ₹315.
